title: Ayr Curling Club
specs: Founded in 1850, one of the oldest curling clubs in the Grand River Area
Facility includes air-conditioned hall, full kitchen and bar, hardwood dance floor, and four sheets of curling ice
Volunteer duties required to keep fees low; 4-5 hours per duty or $100 food/prize contribution
New curlers encouraged to take learn to curl program
Teams can register for competitive leagues; individual sign-up possible for social leagues
Main reception facility accommodates 100 persons; downstairs facility holds 67
